title: Non piangere, idol mio
subtitle: Guglielmo, Ferrando, Don Alfonso, Fiordiligi and Dorabella: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 1

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 4, recitative after No. 6
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (Non piangere, cagion, Chi sa se più ti veggio, quest' infausti, Dei).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 48–49, the recitative between No. 6 and No. 7 (17 bars; Peters notes that it is often left out)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words, the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 75, from the median length of five recordings (Haitink, Solti, Nézet-Séguin, Currentzis, Marriner; just under a minute).

licences.source: Written for this app (from the app's reviewed Così libretto drafts)
